notes: Never reached a 200. Every query shape (project-scoped, group-wide, starred_only) returned the identical 403 {success:false, error:'Activity feed is not enabled'}, which the capability's own guidance documents as: 'A 403 ... means the feed is off for the group, not that the caller lacks permission.' This is a genuine environment precondition (group feature flag) that this read-only round cannot satisfy — enabling a feature flag is not something invokeCapability can do, and no write/destructive capability was invoked per the read-only constraint. Verdict is UNVERIFIED rather than BLOCKED: the contract's own guidance correctly predicted and explained this exact response, so nothing here suggests the index or spec is wrong. What's missing to verify PASS: an account/group in preprod with the activity feed feature flag enabled, so the 200 shape (events[], pagination{next_cursor,has_next_page,limit}, projects{}, optional no_starred_projects) can actually be exercised and its item shape checked against the declared (fully generic, untyped) events[] schema.
